title: A bill to amend the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 to ban soft money donations, increase individual contribution limits to candidates, and increase disclosure for issue advocacy.

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S1597-1598)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Rules and Administration.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Rules and Administration.

summaries.text: Amends the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 to: (1) ban soft money donations of national political party committees; (2) increase from $1,000 to $3,000 the limits for individual contributions to candidates for Federal office; and (3) require additional statements by every person disbursing more than $10,000 during any calendar for electioneering communications (issue advocacy).
